title: What gives a fake competition away?
instruction: Messages and offers from a social network. Tap every part that gives a scam away. If the offer is fine, mark nothing.
debrief: A scam gives itself away by what it wants: money, a card, a password or a code, and right now. A real competition or a friend needs none of that.

segments.text: Congratulations, you’ve won a new phone!

segments.why: You never pay for a real prize.

items.label: Verified cinema profile
items.why: It wants nothing from you and the organiser is real.

segments.text: Write your favourite film in the comments.
We’ll draw the winner on Friday.
Hi, I gave your number instead of mine by mistake.
Please send me the code you just got.
segments.why: The code is the key to your account. And Klára’s account has most likely been stolen.

segments.text: Friends, today I’m giving money away!
and I’ll send you back €40 right away.
segments.why: Doubling your money is a classic scam. The voice and the face may be a deepfake.
A bank never asks you to verify your account on a social network.

segments.text: or it will be blocked within an hour:

segments.why: A strange link. Your bank contacts you in the bank’s app.
